title: Reader Chapter 19
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

examples.title: Applied scenario
examples.scenario: Title: Grace Deletes the First Defense Scenario: "I did not mean it" sits alone in Grace's draft reply at 8:42 p.m. A team-chat notification from Miriam glows beside the meeting transcript note where the accent joke appears. Grace is about to send the defense because it is true. She deletes the sentence and writes first: "I can see that comment made you uncomfortable in front of the team."
examples.whatToDo: Apply the move to the situation.
examples.whyItMatters: It transfers the idea to practice.
